name: Prowlarr
description: One place to manage all your usenet/torrent indexers and sync them into Sonarr, Radarr, Lidarr and friends.
compose:
services:
  prowlarr:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/prowlarr:latest
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:9696"
    environment:
      PUID: "1000"
      PGID: "1000"
      TZ: "UTC"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/config
    restart: unless-stopped
